name: Kampung Stilt House
summary: A traditional Malay timber house raised on stilts, with its gable end and verandah facing the street.
notes: Built in code and exported with plain daytime materials and small painted textures, at real size. Compressed for the web (meshopt geometry). A download copy will be exported from source once the model is cleared.

source.note: Original KL Rush content: the game’s procedural rumah kampung, exported in Chromium by npm run import; see source/HOW.md.
